verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online exposes a REST API with OAuth 2.0 clients (Node.js, PHP SDK) and a first-party MCP server offering full CRUD across 29 entity types, which enables scripted/programmatic (headless) interaction suitable for automation pipelines. However, there is no explicit documentation of running QBO in CI, no sandbox/test-mode guidance for automated pipelines, and openapi/llms.txt probes returned 404s, suggesting API discovery for automated tooling is limited. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD usage guides, sandbox/test environment for automated runs, machine-readable API spec (openapi.json) confirmation.
